caption: The drawing features multiple abstract and stylized figures and symbols rendered primarily in shades of teal, brown, and red. Set against a light brown textured background, two large circular objects with radiating triangular extensions are located in the lower half of the image; each circle is divided centrally and has concentric ring patterns filled with alternating teal, white, and red lines. Between these circles stands a simple humanoid figure outlined in teal with an asymmetrical body. Above the circles, there are two more humanoid shapes: one on the left with outstretched arms, five-fingered hands, and three-toed feet, and another to its right, which appears bulkier and fringed with red and teal spikes along its outline. Near the upper right, there are additional small, simplified humanoid shapes and stylized lines, including one figure with outstretched arms and several detached limb-like elements. At the top right, there are two abstract vertical symbols, each with a base resembling a comb or a set of parallel lines. A small star-like symbol with radiating lines is located just below the upper group of figures. The entire composition is framed within a light beige border.
title: Petroglyph Design
